# rauthy_client (Resource)

Client resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rauthy_client" "google" {
  id                        = "google"
  name                      = "Google"
  confidential              = true
  redirect_uris             = ["http://localhost/callback"]
  post_logout_redirect_uris = ["http://localhost/logout"]
  enabled                   = true
  flows_enabled             = ["authorization_code"]
  access_token_alg          = "EdDSA"
  id_token_alg              = "EdDSA"
  auth_code_lifetime        = 60
  access_token_lifetime     = 1800
  scopes                    = ["openid"]
  challenges                = ["S256"]
  force_mfa                 = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Client ID
- `name` (String) Client name

### Optional

- `access_token_alg` (String) Client access token algorithm
- `access_token_lifetime` (Number) Client access token lifetime
- `auth_code_lifetime` (Number) Client auth code lifetime
- `challenges` (List of String) Client challenges
- `confidential` (Boolean) Client confidential
- `enabled` (Boolean) Client enabled
- `flows_enabled` (List of String) Client flows enabled
- `force_mfa` (Boolean) Client force MFA
- `id_token_alg` (String) Client ID token algorithm
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (List of String) Client post logout redirect URIs
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) Client redirect URIs
- `scopes` (List of String) Client scopes

### Read-Only

- `client_uri` (String) Client URI
- `contacts` (List of String) Client contacts
- `default_scopes` (List of String) Client default scopes
